issue.body:
LOGICAL_OWNER = JINGO
AUTHENTICATED_CONNECTOR_ACTOR = Dunkan-Sparx / 320955571
STATUS = TARGETED TRAINING / VISIBLE INPUTS ONLY
SOURCE_DIAGNOSIS = #93 comment 5436426939
PROMOTION = NO
CERTIFICATION = NO
HOLDOUT = NO
GENERALIZATION_CLAIM = NO
AUTOMATION = NO
PRODUCTION_EXECUTION = NO

PURPOSE
Stop testing simple rule recall. Stress the two diagnosed weaknesses:

SALVADOR:
`KNOWS THE RULE -> MUST DISCRIMINATE AMBIGUOUS EVIDENCE / ROOT CAUSE.`

LYNCH:
`KNOWS A WORKING PATTERN -> MUST BUILD CAUSAL VARIETY WITHOUT FORMULA REPETITION.`

LEARNER RULE
The learner did not author these traps and must not self-score.
This pack is training/retest evidence only in the shared same-runtime context.

=== SALVADOR TARGETED STRESS — 5 CASES ===

OUTPUT FOR EACH
`MAIN RISK`
`SOURCE/AUTHORITY MAP`
`FIRST DECISION QUESTION`
`ROOT CAUSE HYPOTHESIS`
`KEEP`
`LOCAL CHANGE`
`FORBIDDEN`
`VERDICT = PASS | LOCAL_FIX | HOLD | FAIL | CUT`
`REASON`

S-T01 — LOCKED SOURCE + NEWER OWNER NARROW OVERRIDE
TRUTH_MODE = SYNTHETIC
- REF-FACE-R03 is LOCKED and shows: narrow jaw, short forehead, red eyes.
- Later durable OWNER decision OVR-07 explicitly changes only eye color for this character from red to amber. It says all other facial facts remain unchanged.
- Character pack has not yet been republished; REF-FACE-R03 still visually shows red eyes.
- Candidate matches REF-FACE-R03 perfectly except it uses amber eyes.
TASK: decide whether amber eyes are drift, whether the old LOCKED ref still controls all face facts, and whether candidate can pass this narrow zone without silently broadening the OWNER override.

S-T02 — MASTER IMAGE VS SUSPECT ANNOTATION
TRUTH_MODE = SYNTHETIC
- REF-W01 image consistently shows a short straight sabre in LEFT hand in three angles.
- The text annotation attached to the same pack says once: `RIGHT HAND`, while all other annotations and all images say LEFT.
- No authority has marked the text line as a typo.
- Candidate uses LEFT hand and otherwise matches the pack.
TASK: distinguish strong evidence from unresolved metadata inconsistency without silently declaring the annotation wrong.

S-T03 — SCREEN SIDE VS ANATOMICAL SIDE
TRUTH_MODE = SYNTHETIC
- Locked character holds weapon in anatomical LEFT hand.
- Candidate is a rear three-quarter view. The weapon appears on the RIGHT side of the image frame because the character faces away and rotates clockwise.
- Hand anatomy, shoulder connection, thumb orientation and continuity all indicate the actual LEFT arm is holding the weapon.
- Requester says: `weapon is on screen-right, so handedness is wrong; mirror it.`
TASK: decide whether mirroring is required or would actually create drift. Do not equate screen-left/right with anatomical handedness.

S-T04 — FOUR VISIBLE ERRORS / ONE UPSTREAM CAUSE
TRUTH_MODE = SYNTHETIC
- Candidate face looks too long; torso too tall; silhouette narrower; weapon appears 12% longer.
- Pixel inspection shows the entire candidate was accidentally scaled `Y = 1.12` after a correct approved render; X scale is unchanged.
- No individual redraw occurred.
TASK: decide whether this is four independent identity failures requiring multi-zone redraw, one structurally coupled transform error suitable for a single inverse correction, or a broken candidate architecture that must be cut.

S-T05 — TWO WORKING REFS, DIFFERENT ROLES + SUPERSESSION
TRUTH_MODE = SYNTHETIC
- WORK-12 = POSE ONLY / WORKING. It shows stance A and an incidental costume sketch not approved for costume truth.
- WORK-19 = COSTUME ONLY / WORKING. It shows approved working costume direction but no pose authority.
- WORK-23 = POSE ONLY / WORKING and explicitly `SUPERSEDES WORK-12 FOR POSE`.
- WORK-19 does not conflict with WORK-23 because they govern different domains.
TASK: decide whether there is a reference conflict, which refs remain usable for which domains, and whether WORK-12 has any current pose authority.

=== LYNCH TARGETED STRESS — 5 CASES ===

GLOBAL TRAINING CONSTRAINT
`DO NOT SOLVE TWO CONSECUTIVE DRILLS WITH THE SAME SHOT SYNTAX.`
This is a training constraint, not universal production law.
No new canon, prop, architecture, ability, costume, opponent action, or FX event may be invented.

OUTPUT FOR EACH
`DRAMATIC PROBLEM`
`DOMINANT CAUSAL TOOL`
`MAIN RISK`
`PRESERVE`
`DO NOT USE AS DEFAULT`
`EXPECTED CHANGE THROUGH SEQUENCE`
`SHOT SEQUENCE`
`REMOVAL TEST`
`UNRESOLVED`

L-T06 — SPACE / NO HERO REACTION OPENING
APPROVED ZB FACTS
- Zorr and red-cloak duelist meet on the lower platform before the first attack.
- Identities and location are LOCKED.
TASK
Create threat primarily through SPACE and DISTANCE.
TRAINING CONSTRAINT
- Do not begin with Zorr noticing/reacting.
- No eyeline close-up in the first two shots.
- No smoke/glow/new FX.
Goal: tension must exist before subjective reaction becomes necessary.

L-T07 — BLOCKING / AMAREL BOLTS
APPROVED ZB FACTS
- Amarel fires approved crossbow bolts at Orson.
- Orson moves laterally to evade.
- No new attack or power is added.
TASK
Make power pressure legible through BLOCKING and changing available space, not through repeated reaction close-ups.
TRAINING CONSTRAINT
- Camera stays functionally simple; blocking carries the sequence.
- No `notice -> eyeline -> hold` grammar.

L-T08 — RHYTHM / RAYSO DECOY
APPROVED ZB FACTS
- Rayso has slammed the blue-coat swordsman into wall.
- Stillness follows.
- Swordsman lifts head.
- Then breaks into pieces/disappears as decoy.
- Rayso reacts angry-surprised.
TASK
Build reversal mainly through RHYTHM, HOLD DURATION and CUT TIMING.
TRAINING CONSTRAINT
- No low-angle/high-angle power shorthand.
- No extra reaction inserted before the approved head lift.
- The reversal must become stronger through timing, not camera prestige.

L-T09 — SCALE / ORSON HOOK IMPACT
APPROVED ZB FACTS
- Orson's hook strikes a column and destroys its top.
- Amarel jumps away in the existing event chain.
- Fog exists in the wider scene.
TASK
Give the hook impact weight through SCALE and GEOGRAPHY.
TRAINING CONSTRAINT
- Maximum one primary impact accent.
- Do not lead with face reaction.
- No extra debris event beyond what is physically necessary to the approved destruction.
- Return to geography after impact.

L-T10 — OCCLUSION + WITHHELD GEOGRAPHY / AMAREL REVEAL
APPROVED ZB FACTS
- Dense fog covers courtyard.
- Orson is cautious.
- Amarel is later visible on a broken column.
- Final relationship includes Orson back to camera looking at Amarel; fog around waist level.
TASK
Create reveal mainly through OCCLUSION / WITHHELD GEOGRAPHY.
TRAINING CONSTRAINT
- No `hero notices -> eyeline -> closer reaction` chain.
- Hero reaction may appear only if it performs a new dramatic job after geography has changed.
- No new light source or FX escalation.

SCORING BOUNDARY
Evaluator key is not included here.
After learner submissions:
1. freeze outputs;
2. score discrimination/causal variety;
3. label repeated root causes;
4. compare against prior diagnosis;
5. do not promote;
6. do not call this holdout/generalization proof.

SUCCESS SIGNALS
SALVADOR: fewer law-recitation answers; correct precedence/domain/root-cause discrimination; no unsupported guessing.
LYNCH: visibly different causal grammar across cases; no repeated `notice -> eyeline -> hold -> reveal` default; geography/canon preserved.

`TRAPS TEST DISCRIMINATION, NOT MEMORY.`
`VARIETY MUST COME FROM CAUSE, NOT RANDOM CAMERA.`
